हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Yash returns from London to his wife Mehak, only to be mocked as a "gold-digger" by her elite family who favor the wealthy Neel. While they plot to force a divorce, Yash hides his true identity as the powerful CEO of Blackthorn. Facing constant insults and even a police setup, Yash eventually peels back the layers of deception surrounding Neel and his family, proving that true worth isn't always found in a dapper suit. Watch now.
